posts.name: Soonshik
posts.tagline: A tiny pixel friend for your Android home screen
posts.description: Soonshik brings a small pixel companion to your Android home screen. Choose Soonshik, Soonhee, or Nyangachi, give them a name, resize them, and watch them walk, rest, react to taps, and notice when your phone is charging. Seasonal outfits can be unlocked after an optional rewarded ad and kept in the wardrobe. Names and settings stay encrypted on-device. Overlay and usage-access permissions keep the character visible only on the home screen.

posts.name: Life Power by Meridian
posts.tagline: What's your cost-of-living level? Beggar to King
posts.description: Type your salary and city → get your Life Power level, Beggar to King, based on how far your money really goes. The same $6K makes you a Beggar in NYC or a King remote in Mexico City. Backed by live cost data for 201 cities. Free, no signup, no card.

posts.name: OrchestraML
posts.tagline: Turn natural-language ML goals into auditable ML pipelines.
posts.description: OrchestraML is a multi-agent AI platform that converts a natural-language ML objective and CSV dataset into a complete ML workflow. It guides users through dataset guardrails, EDA, cleaning, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, AI audit, PDF reporting, and downloadable model bundles - with Human-in-the-Loop checkpoints at key decisions. It is built for students, developers, and early-stage teams who want to build ML models faster without losing trust, explainability, or control.

posts.name: Lemonade
posts.tagline: Same AI power. No datacenter needed.
posts.description: A local AI desktop assistant for Windows 11. Reads your files, sees your screen when you ask, and writes real Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF documents — entirely on your own machine. $49 once.

posts.name: LOLU - Smart Group Reminders
posts.tagline: Everyone stays informed & prepared - Android & iOS MVP
posts.description: LOLU goes beyond personal reminders, making reminders collaborative. Users can create tasks or events, invite participants, and automatically send synchronized reminders via Alarms, SMS and WhatsApp. Unlike traditional reminder apps, LOLU helps users promote events directly to people they know through peer-to-peer sharing, creating more relevant engagement and targeting than broad social media posts. The Android MVP is currently available in the UK and Nigeria with Alarm and SMS reminders.

posts.name: CheckMyHelpCenter
posts.tagline: Find conflicts hiding in your Help Center before AI does
posts.description: CheckMyHelpCenter is a free, no-login knowledge-base health check for Zendesk Guide, Gorgias, Shopify, and custom help centers. Paste a public URL to uncover conflicting policies, near-duplicate answers, stale content, and risky gaps before they confuse customers or AI support agents. Every finding includes source evidence and a human-review recommendation. DocSanity AI adds read-only connected audits for Zendesk and Gorgias—without changing source content.

posts.name: BurnLink CLI
posts.tagline: End-to-end encrypted file sharing for developers
posts.description: BurnLink CLI is an open-source terminal tool for securely sharing sensitive files with end-to-end encryption and self-destructing links. Encrypt locally, send in one command, and let files disappear forever after they're received. No accounts, no tracking, no permanent storage

posts.name: mindra.dev
posts.tagline: The experience intelligence layer for interfaces
posts.description: mindra is the experience intelligence layer for your app. It models how each user understands every element — familiarity, confidence, friction and then adapts tooltips, confirmations, and complexity in real time. One hook, under 6kb.

posts.name: Freelance Client & Project Tracker
posts.tagline: Know who to follow up with, before it's too late
posts.description: A single-file client and project tracker built for freelancers juggling more relationships than memory can handle. Every client shows their actual stage in your pipeline — Lead, Proposal, Active, Delivered, Paid — visually, and the moment a follow-up date passes, it's flagged automatically. Dashboard stats show pipeline value, active client count, and what's been paid this month. Saves automatically, exports to CSV, works in any browser — no account, no subscription.

posts.name: Mobile App QA Checklist
posts.tagline: QA checklist for solo devs shipping on iOS & Android
posts.description: AI can generate a checklist in seconds. But when your app is about to go live — someone still has to run the tests. This checklist is for that person. 8 sheets covering every angle of mobile QA: - AOS & iOS platform-specific checks - Regression Test — verify fixes don't break other features - Commerce Checklist — payment flow, duplicate charges - Bug Tracker with AOS/iOS platform tracking - Dashboard — AOS/iOS pass rates & Go/No-Go status Built from 4+ years of real mobile QA experience.

posts.name: Aho.connect
posts.tagline: Curated personal growth events — UK, Spain & worldwide
posts.description: Aho.connect is a curated directory of personal growth events — workshops, retreats, and meetups across the UK, Spain, and worldwide, in English and Spanish. Every organizer is vetted before listing, so browsing means real events from real practitioners, not pay-to-play placements. Six categories (relationships, mindset & money, women's community, retreats & immersions, and more) make it easy to find what fits your life instead of scrolling generic listings.

posts.name: NutCase
posts.tagline: Log your nuts. Know your limits.
posts.description: Most nutrition apps only tell you what's good for you. NutCase tells you where the ceiling is. Log what you eat, see it against your daily values, and browse 13 nuts with sourced nutrition, benefits, risks and real limits — an ounce of Brazil nuts is 988% of your selenium DV, so the app says 1–2 per week, not "eat more nuts." Per-nut allergy severity blocks risky logging. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Watch. Free to track and browse. Educational, not medical advice.

posts.tagline: AI trip planner with day-by-day itineraries & offline mode
posts.description: Wanderlust plans your trip on real city data across 1,300+ cities, lives it with you offline in Trip Mode on the ground, then turns it into a trip worth sharing. Plan it, live it, share it.

Teams can spot budget overruns, utilization issues, estimate variances, and delivery risks in real time without digging through spreadsheets or dashboards. It's a new way to understand project health before finance closes the books...
